title: Materials.
officialText:
Pile shells or casings shall be of steel and be sufficiently strong to resist collapse and sufficiently water
tight to exclude any foreign materials during the placing of concrete. Steel shells shall have a sealed tip with a diameter of not
less than 8 inches (203 mm).
